title: A Legacy of Integrity: The Story of Easy Eddie and Butch O'Hare
summary: President Hughes addresses missionaries following the transition of the National Capital Region (NCR) to General Community Quarantine (GCQ). Amid rumors of a potential return to Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ), he encourages them to maintain a positive attitude. The core of his message focuses on integrity, emphasizing that dishonesty always begins with oneself. He shares two interconnected true stories: Al Capone’s brilliant lawyer, 'Easy Eddie,' who sacrificed his life to give his son a good example and name, and his son, Lieutenant Butch O'Hare, the World War II fighter pilot ace and Medal of Honor recipient for whom Chicago's O'Hare Airport is named.
